name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
summary: Support for eligible adult women from low-income households to get an LPG connection.
matchReason: You may meet the age and household criteria. A new connection is subject to the official household and document checks.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
summary: A maternity benefit programme for eligible pregnant and lactating women, subject to scheme conditions.
matchReason: You indicated that you are pregnant or caring for a recent newborn. Check the current registration window and exclusions with your local Anganwadi centre.

name: Lakhpati Didi initiative
summary: Skills and enterprise support for women connected with Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
matchReason: You are part of a Self-Help Group. Ask your SHG or the local rural livelihoods mission about available training and support.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account
summary: A government-backed small savings account that a guardian can open for a girl child under 10.
matchReason: You have a girl child under 10. A parent or guardian can ask a participating bank or post office about opening an account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
summary: A basic savings account for people who do not already have a bank account. Ask a bank branch or Bank Mitra about opening an account and current terms.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
summary: A voluntary renewable life-insurance scheme for eligible bank or post-office account holders. Enrollment and age conditions apply; check current terms with the official portal or your bank.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
summary: A voluntary accident-insurance scheme for eligible bank or post-office account holders. Enrollment and age conditions apply; check current terms with the official portal or your bank.
